title: Seal in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- seal body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#7ea8c4"/>
  <!-- belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="20" ry="13" fill="#b8d4e6"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="20" fill="#7ea8c4"/>
  <!-- face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#a8c8dc"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="40" r="3.5" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="40" r="3.5" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="39" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="39" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="34" y1="46" x2="43" y2="48" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="50" x2="43" y2="50" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="46" x2="57" y2="48" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="50" x2="57" y2="50" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 53 Q50 57 56 53" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M32 58 Q50 66 68 58 L70 64 Q50 72 30 64 Z" fill="#e8544a"/>
  <path d="M64 63 L66 78 L73 76 L70 62 Z" fill="#c8403a"/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d="M38 61 L40 66" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M48 64 L50 69" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 64 L60 69" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 66 L67 72" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#6a96b2" transform="rotate(-20 22 72)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#6a96b2" transform="rotate(20 78 72)"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M50 88 Q42 94 36 90 Q44 92 50 88 Z" fill="#6a96b2"/>
  <path d="M50 88 Q58 94 64 90 Q56 92 50 88 Z" fill="#6a96b2"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="49" r="3" fill="#e88a8a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="49" r="3" fill="#e88a8a" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
